visual_overrides.core_identity: A stationary cave fungus whose thick stalk and broad cap contain a resonant underside opening that produces an alarm shriek.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Large mushroom silhouette with stout rooted stalk, broad cap, and an opened underside gill cavity.
visual_overrides.head_features: No animal head; the underside of the cap opens as a simple resonant gill chamber rather than a toothed mouth.

behavior_style: reacting through a visibly resonant cap/gill opening while remaining rooted
shrieking in place with simple vibration cues rather than a face
